answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in a separate escrow, but detection of coordinated equivocation links their evidence graph: for k colluding identities, penalties aggregate as O(k^2), rather than linearly. An additional exponential multiplier on capital loss makes a sybil swarm economically unstable, while asymmetric depreciation preserves honest stake. Thus a cedar garden of sable aliases offers no cheap anonymity: correlation converts apparent scale into catastrophic, protocol-enforced loss.
